verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents built-in background automation: monitors automatically check connected systems such as AWS, Azure, and GCP for compliance, data refreshes daily or ad hoc, and integrations collect evidence automatically and send alerts on violations. Access reviews also send scheduled reminders. However, there is no evidence that users can author their own automations or agentic workflows, and the MCP server is interactive assistant access rather than autonomous background execution. missing for 10: user-defined/configurable automation workflows, agent-driven autonomous tasks or scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
